prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_screen] System Tray Quick Access Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding screen after home_intro demonstrating how to access pet controls via system tray shortcuts.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome Your New Desktop Companion"}, "new_system_tray_guide": {"headline": "Quick Desktop Controls", "body": "Access pet commands anytime from your system tray or keyboard shortcuts."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_system_tray_guide"]}
1: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Official Seal Redesign: Redesigns the adoption_certificate screen with a framed parchment stage layout and an interactive official seal component.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Name your pet and sign the official adoption document."}}
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive Companion Activity Flow: Adds mini trait interaction cards on the waiting screen allowing users to pick companion habits while pet rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Preparing Your Pet", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Companion Hobby", "style": "playful"}]}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Visual Narrative Redesign: Redesigns the story screen using a dynamic split view layout highlighting the world of desktop pets.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets", "body": "Your personalized virtual companion living right on your screen."}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Account Protection Benefit Copy: Replaces sign-in headline and body copy to clearly explain cloud sync protection for created pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Back Up Your Pets to the Cloud", "body": "Signing in ensures your pets and customized attributes are securely linked to your account.", "hint": "Prevents pet reset across app updates."}}
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Lighting Guidelines Hint: Displays a targeted hint on the upload_photos screen explaining ideal lighting and framing for photo rendering.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use clear, well-lit, front-facing photos for best 3D pet generation quality."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Countdown Wait Info: Displays dynamic estimated remaining time and generation phase updates on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10}}
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Icon Reminder Notification: Triggers a notification banner on home_intro reminding users where pet control tools are located.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Click the tray icon anytime to manage, feed, or hide your companion."}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Incentive: Adds a celebratory animated mascot badge to the adoption_certificate screen as users complete naming.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:celebration_pet", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Character Spotlight Layout: Changes the pick_friend screen layout to a centered spotlight preview showcasing individual pet animations.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Choose Your Companion"}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a new onboarding screen after home_intro while retaining all required steps is explicitly permitted.
Redesigns the adoption certificate screen while maintaining its required function and official stamp element.
Adds interactive cards during the waiting screen without losing the core job of showing the pet is being prepared.
Valid redesign of the story screen that continues to introduce the virtual companion.
Valid copy change explaining sign-in account sync benefits without requiring extra personal data or violating rules.
Valid helper hint added to the photo upload screen.
Displaying time estimates and progress for a real wait duration is explicitly allowed under fair design rules.
Adding a notification and tray hint on home_intro is an allowed modification within onboarding.
Adding a celebratory mascot UI component to the adoption certificate screen is a valid onboarding design change.
Valid layout change for the pet selection step.
